AC8 (`make verify`) PASS on the committed tree: exit 0, 20045 passed / 28 skipped, 1:12:27 wall. The run overlapped with dbac's verify on the same host, which is why it ran well over the usual 20-25 minutes. AC1-AC7 PASS via `.rebar/scratch/ac-34ec.sh` (exits 0). All 8 acceptance criteria are met.

Final diff was 2 hunks in the single `file_impact` path, `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`: the `| default | ... |` row dropped from the closed key-set table, and the §4 invariants sentence reduced to the surviving `dimension`-collision invariant with "Invariants" to "The invariant".
